zh: 不看数据：每一局都报先验均值。它是这套玩法的基准，得分按定义是 1。
en: Ignore the data: report the prior mean in every episode. It is this game's benchmark, and its score is 1 by definition.

zh: 真值的先验均值
en: prior mean of the true value

zh: 标准估计：用到目前为止的全部观测，套教科书上的公式。
en: Standard estimator: apply the textbook formula to all the observations so far.

zh: 第 0 个到第 t 个观测，一个不落
en: observations 0 through t, every one of them

zh: 只用最近一段：只取最近比例为 w 的那一段观测来算标准估计。
en: Use only the recent part: compute the standard estimator from only the most recent fraction w of the observations.

zh: 降采样：每隔 k 个观测才取一个（时间跨度不变，点数只剩 1/k），再算标准估计。
en: Subsample: keep only every k-th observation (the time span is unchanged, only 1/k of the points remain), then compute the standard estimator.

zh: 向先验收缩：标准估计和先验均值之间按权重 w 取一个折中。w = 1 就是标准估计，w = 0 就是不看数据。
en: Shrink toward the prior: take a compromise, with weight w, between the standard estimator and the prior mean. With w = 1 it is the standard estimator; with w = 0 it ignores the data.

zh: 折半去偏（刀切法）：全部数据算一次，前一半、后一半各算一次；2 × 全部 − 两个半段的平均，把与样本长度成反比的偏差消掉。
en: Split-half bias correction (jackknife): estimate once from all the data and once each from the first half and the second half; 2 × the full estimate − the average of the two half estimates cancels the bias that is inversely proportional to the sample length.

zh: 测漂移时用后验均值：把收缩的权重写成"已经看了多久"的函数，而不是一个常数
en: When measuring the drift, use the posterior mean: write the shrinkage weight as a function of "how long you have observed so far" instead of a constant

zh: 测波动时用绝对值的中位数（对离群点不敏感），再和标准估计比一比
en: When measuring the volatility, use the median of the absolute values (insensitive to outliers), then compare it with the standard estimator

zh: 测回复速度时先减去 4/总时长 这个已知的偏差，再收回到范围里
en: When measuring the reversion speed, first subtract the known bias 4/(total duration), then clamp the result back into the range

zh: 每一局给你一条轨迹，背后有一个你看不到的参数（漂移、波动、回复速度或者 Hurst 指数），它每一局都不一样。看完轨迹，报出你的估计。
en: Each episode gives you one trajectory. Behind it is a parameter you cannot see (the drift, the volatility, the reversion speed or the Hurst exponent), and it is different in every episode. After watching the trajectory, report your estimate.

zh: 世界 · 测什么
en: World · what to measure

zh: 布朗运动 · 测漂移 μ
en: Brownian motion · measure drift μ

zh: 布朗运动 · 测波动 σ
en: Brownian motion · measure volatility σ

zh: 均值回复 · 测回复速度 κ
en: Mean reversion · measure reversion speed κ

zh: 分数布朗运动 · 测 Hurst 指数 H
en: Fractional Brownian motion · measure Hurst exponent H

zh: X 每单位时间平均移动 μ，再叠加波动 σ 的随机游走。σ 已知，μ 每局不同。
en: X moves by μ per unit time on average, with a random walk of volatility σ added on top. σ is known; μ differs from episode to episode.

zh: 没有漂移的随机游走，波动 σ 每局不同。
en: A random walk with no drift; the volatility σ differs from episode to episode.

zh: X 被一根弹簧拉回平衡位置（位置未知），回复速度 κ 每局不同；偏离的半衰期是 ln2/κ。
en: X is pulled back to an equilibrium position by a spring (the position is unknown), and the reversion speed κ differs from episode to episode; the half-life of a deviation is ln2/κ.

zh: 增量之间有长程相关：H > ½ 时趋势延续，H < ½ 时来回震荡，H = ½ 就是布朗运动。
en: The increments have long-range correlation: for H > ½ trends persist, for H < ½ the path oscillates back and forth, and H = ½ is Brownian motion.

zh: 采样点数 n
en: Number of sample points n

zh: 总时长 D
en: Total duration D

zh: n 个点均匀地铺在这段时间里。想成"年"的话，D = 1、n = 250 就是一年的日线
en: The n points are spread evenly over this time span. If you think of the unit as a "year", D = 1 with n = 250 is one year of daily data

zh: 波动 σ（已知）
en: Volatility σ (known)

zh: 每单位时间的标准差
en: Standard deviation per unit time

zh: 漂移真值的分散程度 τ
en: Spread of the true drift τ

zh: 每一局的漂移从 N(0, τ²) 里抽
en: Each episode's drift is drawn from N(0, τ²)

zh: σ 的下限
en: Lower limit of σ

zh: σ 的上限
en: Upper limit of σ

zh: 每一局的 σ 在上下限之间按对数均匀地抽
en: Each episode's σ is drawn log-uniformly between the lower and upper limits

zh: κ 的单位是"每单位时间"：κ·D 是这段时间里偏离衰减了多少个 e 倍
en: The unit of κ is "per unit time": κ·D is the number of e-foldings by which a deviation decays over this time span

zh: κ 的下限
en: Lower limit of κ

zh: κ 的上限
en: Upper limit of κ

zh: 每一局的 κ 在上下限之间按对数均匀地抽
en: Each episode's κ is drawn log-uniformly between the lower and upper limits

zh: H 的下限
en: Lower limit of H

zh: H 的上限
en: Upper limit of H

zh: 每一局的 H 在上下限之间均匀地抽
en: Each episode's H is drawn uniformly between the lower and upper limits

zh: 剩余误差（1 = 等于没测）
en: Remaining error (1 = same as not measuring)

zh: 估计的误差（以真值的分散程度为单位）
en: Error of the estimate (in units of the spread of the true value)

zh: 轨迹 X
en: Trajectory X

zh: 增量
en: Increment

zh: 相邻两个观测之差 X(i+1) − X(i)
en: Difference between adjacent observations X(i+1) − X(i)

zh: 你报的估计
en: Your reported estimate

zh: 平均偏差（估计 − 真值）
en: Average bias (estimate − truth)

zh: 平均绝对误差
en: Mean absolute error

zh: 不看数据，报先验均值（按定义）
en: Ignore the data, report the prior mean (by definition)

zh: 标准估计（公式 σ²/(Dτ²)）
en: Standard estimator (formula σ²/(Dτ²))

zh: 理论最优：后验均值（公式 1/(1 + Dτ²/σ²)）
en: Theoretical optimum: posterior mean (formula 1/(1 + Dτ²/σ²))

zh: 理论：w²·σ²/(Dτ²) + (1 − w)²
en: Theory: w²·σ²/(Dτ²) + (1 − w)²

zh: 不看数据，报先验均值
en: Ignore the data, report the prior mean

zh: 向先验收缩（w = §0§）
en: Shrink toward the prior (w = §0§)

zh: 波动 · 30 个点
en: Volatility · 30 points

zh: 动作：返回你对这一局那个参数的估计（一个数）。裁判只在一部分时刻来问（观测数每增加一成问一次），最后一个观测到手时一定问；计分只看最后一次。没给出有限的数时，按先验均值算。
en: Action: return your estimate of this episode's parameter (one number). The referee asks only at some of the times (once each time the number of observations has grown by one tenth) and always asks when the last observation arrives; only the last answer is scored. If you do not return a finite number, the prior mean is used.

zh: s.mle(a, b, k)   标准估计：用第 a 个到第 b 个观测、每隔 k 个取一个算出来（b 不能超过 s.t）；观测太少算不出来时返回先验均值。公式见手册里这套玩法的那一页
en: s.mle(a, b, k)   The standard estimator computed from observations a through b, taking every k-th one (b cannot exceed s.t); returns the prior mean when there are too few observations to compute it. The formulas are on this game's page in the handbook

zh: s.t              现在手里最后一个观测的编号（从 0 起）；s.p(k) 是 k 个观测之前的 X，s.p(0) 是最新的那个
en: s.t              Index of the last observation you now hold (counting from 0); s.p(k) is X from k observations ago, and s.p(0) is the latest one

zh: s.ret(k)         最近第 k+1 个增量 X(i+1) − X(i)；s.rets(n)、s.mean(n)、s.vol(n) 是最近 n 个增量组成的数组、均值、标准差
en: s.ret(k)         The (k+1)-th most recent increment X(i+1) − X(i); s.rets(n), s.mean(n), s.vol(n) are the array, the mean and the standard deviation of the last n increments

zh: s.prices(n)      最近 n 个观测组成的数组（旧的在前）；s.sma(n)、s.psd(n) 是它们的均值和标准差
en: s.prices(n)      Array of the last n observations (oldest first); s.sma(n) and s.psd(n) are their mean and standard deviation

zh: s.g.what         这一局测什么："mu" 漂移、"sigma" 波动、"kappa" 回复速度、"hurst" Hurst 指数
en: s.g.what         What this episode measures: "mu" drift, "sigma" volatility, "kappa" reversion speed, "hurst" Hurst exponent

zh: s.g.dt  s.g.span 相邻两个观测隔多久、全部观测一共跨多久（Hurst 那一档里时间步长记作 1）
en: s.g.dt  s.g.span Time between adjacent observations, and the total time spanned by all the observations (in the Hurst setting the time step is taken to be 1)

zh: s.g.m0  s.g.v0   真值的先验均值和先验方差；s.g.lo、s.g.hi 是真值的范围（漂移没有范围）
en: s.g.m0  s.g.v0   Prior mean and prior variance of the true value; s.g.lo and s.g.hi are the range of the true value (the drift has no range)

zh: s.g.sigma s.g.tau 测漂移时：已知的波动 σ，和漂移真值的分散程度 τ（每局的漂移从 N(0, τ²) 里抽）
en: s.g.sigma s.g.tau When measuring the drift: the known volatility σ, and the spread τ of the true drift (each episode's drift is drawn from N(0, τ²))

zh: 理论最优 = 原地不动（鞅）
en: Theoretical optimum = Stay put (martingale)

zh: 理论最优：(1 − φ^h)/2（知道 φ 和均值）
en: Theoretical optimum: (1 − φ^h)/2 (knowing φ and the mean)

zh: 知道 H、用最近 60 个增量的最优线性预测
en: Optimal linear forecast knowing H and using the last 60 increments

zh: 理论最优：知道两个系数的线性预测
en: Theoretical optimum: the linear forecast that knows the two coefficients

zh: 理论上界：知道方程就能完全预测
en: Theoretical upper bound: knowing the equation allows perfect prediction

zh: 理论上界：确定性系统，原则上可以完全预测
en: Theoretical upper bound: a deterministic system, in principle perfectly predictable

zh: 原地不动：预测 h 步之后还是现在这个值。它是这套玩法的基准，技巧分按定义是 0。
en: Stay put: forecast that the value h steps ahead will still be the current value. It is this game's benchmark, and its skill score is 0 by definition.

zh: s.x 是这一步刚看到的观测值
en: s.x is the value observed at this step

zh: 线性外推：最近一步变了多少，就认为接下来每一步都照这样变（乘上力度 w）。
en: Linear extrapolation: assume that every coming step changes by as much as the latest step did (multiplied by a strength w).

zh: s.p(1) 是上一步的观测值
en: s.p(1) is the value observed one step ago

zh: 回到均值：把到现在为止的平均值当作归宿，预测"现在的偏离到时候只剩 w 倍"。
en: Revert to the mean: take the average so far as the destination, and forecast that "by then only a fraction w of the current deviation will be left".

zh: 到现在为止全部观测的平均
en: the average of all observations so far

zh: 自回归（递推最小二乘）：把 h 步之后的值写成最近 q 个值的线性组合；每过一步，就用刚揭晓的答案修正一次系数。
en: Autoregression (recursive least squares): write the value h steps ahead as a linear combination of the last q values; after every step, correct the coefficients once with the answer that has just been revealed.

zh: P 是系数的"不确定程度"，开局时很大
en: P is the uncertainty about the coefficients; large at the start

zh: 1) h 步之前的那组"最近 q 个值"，现在有了答案（就是 s.x）：用它修正系数
en: 1) The "last q values" from h steps ago now have their answer (it is s.x): use it to update the coefficients

zh: 都减去开局的值 x0，数值上稳一些
en: subtract the starting value x0 from everything, for numerical stability

zh: 2) 用现在的系数预测 h 步之后
en: 2) Forecast h steps ahead with the current coefficients

zh: 数据太少：先原地不动
en: too little data: stay put for now

zh: 相似历史（最近邻）：在过去找出和"刚走过的这一小段"最像的 k 段，看它们后来各走了多少，取平均。
en: Similar histories (nearest neighbors): find the k segments of the past most similar to "the short segment just traveled", see how far each of them moved afterward, and take the average.

zh: 历史太短：先原地不动
en: history too short: stay put for now

zh: 从开局到现在的全部观测值：X[0] … X[t]
en: all observed values from the start until now: X[0] … X[t]

zh: 候选是过去的每一个时刻 u（它后面的 h 步已经发生过了）。两段轨迹的距离 = 逐点相减的平方和
en: The candidates are all past times u (whose next h steps have already happened). Distance between two segments = sum of squared pointwise differences

zh: 现在的值 + 那几段后来的平均变化
en: the current value + the average change that followed those segments

zh: 先判断这个世界是随机游走还是有结构：两种预测都算，哪个最近的误差小就用哪个
en: First decide whether this world is a random walk or has structure: compute both forecasts and use whichever has had the smaller error recently

zh: 最近邻里按距离加权，而不是简单平均
en: Weight the nearest neighbors by distance instead of taking a simple average

zh: 提前 h 步时，把一步的预测迭代 h 次，和直接预测 h 步比一比
en: When forecasting h steps ahead, iterate the one-step forecast h times and compare it with forecasting h steps directly

zh: 一个量随时间变化。每一步，你报出它 h 步之后会是多少。和"原地不动"（预测它不变）比：少掉了多少均方误差。
en: A quantity changes over time. At every step you report what it will be h steps ahead. Compared with "Stay put" (forecasting that it does not change): how much of the mean squared error you removed.

zh: 布朗运动（随机游走）
en: Brownian motion (random walk)

zh: Logistic 映射（混沌）
en: Logistic map (chaos)

zh: 洛伦兹系统（混沌）
en: Lorenz system (chaos)

zh: 每一步加上一个独立的标准正态增量。
en: Each step adds an independent standard normal increment.

zh: 偏离均值的部分每一步只留下 φ 倍，再加上新的噪声。平稳标准差是 1。
en: At each step only a fraction φ of the deviation from the mean is kept, and new noise is added. The stationary standard deviation is 1.

zh: 增量之间有长程相关：H > ½ 时趋势延续，H < ½ 时来回震荡。
en: The increments have long-range correlation: for H > ½ trends persist, for H < ½ the path oscillates back and forth.

zh: 被随机力推动的欠阻尼振子：x(t) = 2ρcos(2π/周期)·x(t−1) − ρ²·x(t−2) + 噪声。
en: An underdamped oscillator driven by a random force: x(t) = 2ρcos(2π/period)·x(t−1) − ρ²·x(t−2) + noise.

zh: x(t+1) = a·x(t)·(1 − x(t))。没有任何随机性，但看起来像噪声。
en: x(t+1) = a·x(t)·(1 − x(t)). There is no randomness at all, yet it looks like noise.

zh: 三个变量的确定性方程组，你只看得到其中一个，每隔 τ 采样一次。
en: A deterministic system of equations in three variables; you see only one of them, sampled at intervals of τ.

zh: 提前几步 h
en: Steps ahead h

zh: 热身的步数（不计分）
en: Warm-up steps (not scored)

zh: 给需要先学一会儿的规则留的时间
en: Time set aside for rules that need to learn for a while first

zh: 每步保留的偏离 φ
en: Deviation kept per step φ

zh: 半衰期 = ln 2 ÷ ln(1/φ) 步
en: Half-life = ln 2 ÷ ln(1/φ) steps

zh: a = 4 时相邻两步的线性相关恰好是 0
en: At a = 4 the linear correlation between adjacent steps is exactly 0

zh: 观测噪声（信号标准差的倍数）
en: Observation noise (in signal standard deviations)

zh: 技巧分（比原地不动少掉的均方误差比例）
en: Skill score (share of mean squared error removed vs "Stay put")

zh: 累计少掉的平方误差
en: Cumulative squared error removed

zh: 观测值
en: Observed value

zh: 相邻两个观测值之差
en: Difference between adjacent observed values

zh: 你的预测（h 步之后）
en: Your forecast (h steps ahead)

zh: 你的均方根误差
en: Your root-mean-square error

zh: 原地不动的均方根误差
en: Root-mean-square error of "Stay put"

zh: 原地不动（按定义）
en: Stay put (by definition)

zh: 理论（均值已知时）
en: Theory (when the mean is known)

zh: 自回归（q = 3）
en: Autoregression (q = 3)

zh: 相似历史（m = 2，k = 4）
en: Similar histories (m = 2, k = 4)

zh: 知道方程的预测（这一批对局上算的）
en: Forecast that knows the equation (computed on this batch of episodes)

zh: 动作：返回你对 h 步之后那个观测值的预测（一个数）。没给出有限的数时，按"原地不动"算。前面热身的那些步照样会来问，只是不计分。
en: Action: return your forecast of the observed value h steps ahead (one number). If you do not return a finite number, it counts as "Stay put". You are still asked during the warm-up steps at the start, but they are not scored.

zh: s.x          这一步刚看到的观测值；s.p(k) 是 k 步之前的观测值（s.p(0) 就是 s.x）
en: s.x          The observed value just seen at this step; s.p(k) is the observed value k steps ago (s.p(0) is s.x)

zh: s.ret(k)     最近第 k+1 个增量；s.rets(n)、s.mean(n)、s.vol(n) 是最近 n 个增量组成的数组、均值、标准差
en: s.ret(k)     The (k+1)-th most recent increment; s.rets(n), s.mean(n), s.vol(n) are the array, the mean and the standard deviation of the last n increments

zh: s.prices(n)  最近 n 个观测值组成的数组（旧的在前）；s.sma(n)、s.psd(n) 是它们的均值和标准差
en: s.prices(n)  Array of the last n observed values (oldest first); s.sma(n) and s.psd(n) are their mean and standard deviation

zh: s.g.h        提前几步；s.g.warm 热身的步数；s.g.T 一局多少步；s.t 现在是第几步（从 0 起）
en: s.g.h        Steps ahead; s.g.warm is the number of warm-up steps; s.g.T is the number of steps per episode; s.t is the current step number (counting from 0)

zh: 规则不知道这是哪一种世界，也读不到世界的参数：要么把这份知识写进规则的参数里，要么从数据里学。
en: The rule does not know which kind of world this is and cannot read the world's parameters: either write that knowledge into the rule's parameters or learn it from the data.

zh: 单点超限：某一个读数高过 k 就报警（休哈特控制图）。它是这套玩法的基准。
en: Single reading over the limit: raise the alarm when any single reading is above k (the Shewhart control chart). It is this game's benchmark.

zh: s.x 是这一步的读数，单位是噪声的标准差
en: s.x is this step's reading, in units of the noise standard deviation

zh: 滑动平均超限：最近 n 个读数的平均值高过 c/√n 就报警（n 个独立读数的平均，标准差是 1/√n）。
en: Moving average over the limit: raise the alarm when the average of the last n readings is above c/√n (the average of n independent readings has standard deviation 1/√n).

zh: s.mean(j) 是这一步之前最近 j 个读数的平均
en: s.mean(j) is the average of the last j readings before this step

zh: 累积和（CUSUM）：把每个读数超出参考值 k 的部分累加起来，跌到 0 以下就从 0 重新开始；累到 h 就报警。
en: Cumulative sum (CUSUM): add up the excess of each reading over the reference value k, restart from 0 whenever the sum falls below 0, and raise the alarm when it reaches h.

zh: 截断的累积和：先把每个读数收到 ±c 之内，再做累积和。一个离谱的读数最多只能把 S 推高 c − k。
en: Clipped cumulative sum: first clip each reading to within ±c, then run the cumulative sum. A single extreme reading can push S up by at most c − k.

zh: 截断
en: clip

zh: 后验概率（Shiryaev）：每看到一个读数，就用贝叶斯公式更新"变化已经发生"的概率 π；π 超过 A 就报警。
en: Posterior probability (Shiryaev): with each new reading, use Bayes' formula to update the probability π that "the change has already occurred"; raise the alarm when π exceeds A.

zh: 这一步之前，变化又有 ρ 的概率刚刚发生
en: before this step, the change has just happened with probability ρ

zh: 似然比：读数 x 在"已变"和"未变"两种情形下的概率密度之比
en: likelihood ratio: the density of the reading x under "changed" divided by its density under "not changed"

zh: 动态规划：把"变化已经发生"的后验概率 π 当作状态，从最后一步往前倒推每一步的报警线。
en: Dynamic programming: take the posterior probability π that "the change has already occurred" as the state, and work backward from the last step to get the alarm threshold at every step.

zh: 假设：噪声是标准正态，变化之后均值抬高 δ，每一步之前有 ρ 的概率发生变化（这些都是细则里写明的）。
en: Assumptions: the noise is standard normal, the change raises the mean by δ, and before each step the change happens with probability ρ (all of this is stated in the rulebook).

zh: 状态用 π 的对数几率 l = ln(π/(1−π))：看到读数 y 之后，l 变成 logit(π + (1−π)ρ) + δ·y − δ²/2。
en: The state is the log-odds of π, l = ln(π/(1−π)): after a reading y, l becomes logit(π + (1−π)ρ) + δ·y − δ²/2.

zh: V[l]：走到这一步、后验是 π 时，从这里到终局最少还要付出多少期望代价。
en: V[l]: the least expected cost still to be paid from here to the end, given you are at this step with posterior π.

zh: 现在报警：F·(1−π)（报错了才罚）；再等一步：π（变化若已发生，这一步就是一步延迟）+ E[下一步的 V]。
en: Raise the alarm now: F·(1−π) (the penalty applies only if it is false); wait one step: π (if the change has happened, this step is one step of delay) + E[next step's V].

zh: 标准正态在等距格点上的权重
en: weights of the standard normal on an evenly spaced grid

zh: 后验是 pi 时，下一步的 V 的期望
en: the expectation of the next step's V when the posterior is pi
changed: reading ~ N(δ, 1); not changed: ~ N(0, 1)

zh: 2 = 这一步无论如何都不报
en: 2 = never raise the alarm at this step

zh: 从 π = 1 往下扫：报警更划算的那一段的下端就是报警线
en: sweep down from π = 1: the lower end of the stretch where raising the alarm is cheaper is the alarm threshold

zh: 倒推出的报警线：开局 π ≥ §0§，中段 §1§，最后一步 §2§。按这些假设，期望代价是 §3§ 步。
en: Alarm thresholds from the backward induction: π ≥ §0§ at the start, §1§ mid-episode, §2§ at the last step. Under these assumptions the expected cost is §3§ steps.

zh: 不报
en: no alarm

zh: 用最近 13 个读数的中位数代替平均值，超过 3/√13 就报（中位数不怕离群点）
en: Replace the average with the median of the last 13 readings and raise the alarm when it exceeds 3/√13 (the median is not thrown off by outliers)

zh: 幅度不知道时：同时跑三条累积和（参考值 0.25、0.5、1），任何一条越线就报
en: When the shift size is unknown: run three cumulative sums at once (reference values 0.25, 0.5, 1) and raise the alarm as soon as any of them crosses its threshold

zh: 报警线随剩余步数变化：快到终局时更不愿意报
en: Let the alarm threshold vary with the number of steps left: be more reluctant to raise the alarm near the end of the episode

zh: 报警（报对了）
en: Alarm (correct)

zh: 误报
en: False alarm

zh: 一串带噪声的读数。在某个你不知道的时刻，它的均值悄悄抬高了一点。你要尽早报警，但报早了（变化还没发生）要罚。
en: A stream of noisy readings. At some moment you do not know, its mean quietly rises a little. You must raise the alarm as early as possible, but raising it too early (before the change has occurred) is penalized.

zh: 正态噪声，幅度已知
en: Normal noise, known shift size

zh: 正态噪声，幅度不确定
en: Normal noise, unknown shift size

zh: 厚尾噪声（Student-t，自由度 3）
en: Heavy-tailed noise (Student-t, 3 degrees of freedom)

zh: 噪声是标准正态；变化之后均值正好抬高 δ。
en: The noise is standard normal; after the change the mean is higher by exactly δ.

zh: 噪声是标准正态；实际抬高的幅度每局不同，在 δ 的一半到两倍之间（对数均匀），规则只知道名义值 δ。
en: The noise is standard normal; the actual size of the rise differs from episode to episode, between half and twice δ (log-uniform), and the rule knows only the nominal value δ.

zh: 噪声的方差仍是 1，但服从自由度 3 的 t 分布：偶尔会蹦出一个很离谱的读数。
en: The noise still has variance 1 but follows a t distribution with 3 degrees of freedom: occasionally a wildly extreme reading turns up.

zh: 平均多少步之后发生变化 1/ρ
en: Average steps until the change 1/ρ

zh: 每一步之前，变化有 ρ 的概率发生；可能到终局都没发生
en: Before each step the change occurs with probability ρ; it may not have occurred by the end of the episode

zh: 变化的幅度 δ
en: Shift size δ

zh: 以噪声的标准差为单位
en: In units of the standard deviation of the noise

zh: 一次误报的代价 F
en: Cost of one false alarm F

zh: 相当于晚报多少步
en: Equivalent to raising the alarm this many steps late

zh: 平均代价（步）
en: Average cost (steps)

zh: 累计代价
en: Cumulative cost

zh: 读数
en: Reading

zh: 报警
en: Alarm

zh: 误报的比例
en: Share of false alarms

zh: 报对时平均晚了几步
en: Average steps late when the alarm is correct

zh: 变了却一直没报的比例
en: Share with a change but no alarm

zh: 从不报警（公式）
en: Never raise the alarm (formula)

zh: 理论最优（动态规划）
en: Theoretical optimum (dynamic programming)

zh: 单点超限（k = 3）
en: Single reading over the limit (k = 3)

zh: 累积和 CUSUM（k = §0§，h = §1§）
en: Cumulative sum CUSUM (k = §0§, h = §1§)

zh: 动态规划（按正态噪声、幅度 δ 算）
en: Dynamic programming (computed for normal noise and shift size δ)

zh: 动作：返回 1（或任何 ≥ 0.5 的数）= 现在报警，这一局到此结束；返回 0 = 继续看。
en: Action: return 1 (or any number ≥ 0.5) = raise the alarm now, and the episode ends there; return 0 = keep watching.

zh: s.x          这一步的读数（噪声的标准差是 1）
en: s.x          The reading at this step (the noise has standard deviation 1)

zh: s.ret(k)     k+1 步之前的读数；s.rets(n)、s.mean(n)、s.vol(n) 是这一步之前最近 n 个读数组成的数组、均值、标准差
en: s.ret(k)     The reading k+1 steps ago; s.rets(n), s.mean(n), s.vol(n) are the array, the mean and the standard deviation of the last n readings before this step

zh: s.g.rho      每一步之前发生变化的概率；s.g.delta 变化的（名义）幅度；s.g.F 一次误报的代价；s.g.T 一局多少步；s.t 现在是第几步
en: s.g.rho      Probability that the change occurs before each step; s.g.delta is the (nominal) shift size; s.g.F is the cost of one false alarm; s.g.T is the number of steps per episode; s.t is the current step number

zh: 规则不知道变化发生了没有，也不知道这是哪一种世界：厚尾、幅度不确定这些，都得你自己防。
en: The rule does not know whether the change has occurred, nor which kind of world this is: heavy tails, an unknown shift size and the like are things you have to guard against yourself.

zh: 走到头：从不主动停。它是这套玩法的基准。
en: Go to the end: never stop of your own accord. It is this game's benchmark.

zh: 0 = 继续走，1 = 现在停
en: 0 = keep going, 1 = stop now

zh: 立刻停：第一步就停，手里的值是 0。
en: Stop immediately: stop at the very first step; the value in hand is 0.

zh: 固定回落：从到目前为止的最高点回落超过 d 就停。
en: Fixed pullback: stop when the pullback from the maximum so far exceeds d.

zh: s.hi(n) 是最近 n 个值里最大的；s.t + 1 个就是从开局到现在
en: s.hi(n) is the largest of the last n values; s.t + 1 of them covers everything from the start until now

zh: 回落超过 z·√剩余步数 就停：剩的时间越少，越小的回落就该停。
en: Stop on a pullback beyond z·√(steps left): the less time is left, the smaller the pullback at which you should stop.

zh: 照搬秘书问题：前一段时间只看不停，之后一旦回到（或超过）此前的最高点就停。
en: Copy the secretary rule: for an initial stretch of time only watch and do not stop; after that, stop as soon as the path returns to (or exceeds) the previous maximum.

zh: 动态规划：把"还剩几步、现在离最高点多远"当作状态，从最后一步往前倒推每个状态下该停还是该走。
en: Dynamic programming: take "how many steps are left and how far the path now is from the maximum" as the state, and work backward from the last step to decide in every state whether to stop or to go on.

zh: 假设：每一步的增量互相独立，服从 N(μ, 1)。记 s = 还剩几步，y = 现在离到目前为止的最高点多远（y ≥ 0）。
en: Assumptions: the increments are independent and N(μ, 1). Let s = the number of steps left and y = the current distance below the running maximum (y ≥ 0).

zh: 现在停下：最后离全程最高点的距离是 Z = max(y, 之后 s 步里从现在算起的最大涨幅)。
en: Stop now: the final distance from the overall maximum is Z = max(y, the largest rise from the current level over the remaining s steps).

zh: m1[y] = E[Z]，m2[y] = E[Z²]（现在停的代价），V[y] = 按最优方式走下去的代价。三张表都按 s = 0, 1, 2, … 往上递推：
en: m1[y] = E[Z], m2[y] = E[Z²] (the cost of stopping now), V[y] = the cost of continuing optimally. All three tables are built up recursively for s = 0, 1, 2, …:

zh: 先走一步 Δ，则 Z = Δ + Z'，Z' 是"还剩 s−1 步、离最高点 max(y − Δ, 0)"时的 Z。
en: Take one step Δ first; then Z = Δ + Z', where Z' is the Z for "s−1 steps left, max(y − Δ, 0) below the maximum".

zh: 增量取在间距 dy 的格点上（权重按正态密度），这样 y − Δ 总落在格点上，不用插值。
en: The increments live on a grid of spacing dy (weighted by the normal density), so y − Δ always lands on a grid point and no interpolation is needed.

zh: 网格之外：离最高点太远，之后不会再创新高
en: off the grid: too far below the maximum to set a new high again

zh: 倒推的结果：开局时回落超过 §0§ 才停，走到一半时是 §1§，最后一步是 §2§。按这些假设，期望代价是 §3§（立刻停是 §4§）。
en: Result of the backward induction: at the start, stop only when the pullback exceeds §0§; halfway through it is §1§, and at the last step §2§. Under these assumptions the expected cost is §3§ (stopping immediately gives §4§).

zh: 表格之外：比较"现在停"和"走到头"
en: outside the table: compare "stop now" with "go to the end"

zh: 报警线不用 √剩余步数，改成剩余步数的别的次幂，扫描一下指数
en: For the stopping boundary, replace √(steps left) with another power of the steps left, and sweep the exponent

zh: 有向上的漂移时：除非只剩最后几步，否则一直走
en: With an upward drift: keep going unless only the last few steps are left

zh: 均值回复的世界里：高出均值一定幅度就停，不看回落
en: In the mean-reverting world: stop once the value is a certain amount above the mean, regardless of the pullback

zh: 停在这里
en: Stopped here

zh: 看着一条路径一步一步往前走。你可以在任何一步喊停，喊了就不能反悔；不喊就走到头。目标是停下的地方离整条路径的最高点尽量近。
en: Watch a path move forward one step at a time. You may call a stop at any step, and once you have called it you cannot go back on it; if you never call it, the path runs to the end. The goal is to stop as close as possible to the maximum of the whole path.

zh: 厚尾步长（Student-t，自由度 3）
en: Heavy-tailed steps (Student-t, 3 degrees of freedom)

zh: 从 0 出发，每一步加上 μ 和一个标准正态增量。
en: Starting from 0, each step adds μ and a standard normal increment.

zh: 步长的方差仍是 1，但服从自由度 3 的 t 分布：偶尔一步跨得很远。
en: The steps still have variance 1 but follow a t distribution with 3 degrees of freedom: now and then a single step goes very far.

zh: 从均值 0 出发，偏离每一步只留下 φ 倍，再加噪声；平稳标准差是 1。
en: Starting from the mean 0, at each step only a fraction φ of the deviation is kept and noise is added; the stationary standard deviation is 1.

zh: 每步的漂移 μ
en: Drift per step μ

zh: 以步长的标准差为单位
en: In units of the standard deviation of one step

zh: 离最高点距离的平方
en: Squared distance from the maximum

zh: 离最高点距离的平方 ÷ 步数
en: Squared distance from the maximum ÷ number of steps

zh: 手里的值
en: Value in hand

zh: 步长
en: Step size

zh: 每一步走了多少
en: How far each step moved

zh: 停
en: Stop

zh: 停在全程的什么位置
en: Where along the path you stopped

zh: 离最高点的平均距离（以 √步数 为单位）
en: Average distance from the maximum (in units of √(number of steps))

zh: 走到头（递推）
en: Go to the end (by recursion)

zh: 立刻停（递推）
en: Stop immediately (by recursion)

zh: 连续时间的最优值 2Φ(z*) − 1（步数趋于无穷时的极限）
en: Continuous-time optimum 2Φ(z*) − 1 (the limit as the number of steps tends to infinity)

zh: 回落超过 1.12·√剩余步数 就停
en: Stop on a pullback beyond 1.12·√(steps left)

zh: 动态规划（按正态步长§0§算）
en: Dynamic programming (computed for normal steps§0§)

zh: 、没有回复
en: and no reversion

zh: 动作：返回 1（或任何 ≥ 0.5 的数）= 现在停，手里的值就定在这一步的 s.x；返回 0 = 继续走。一直不停，就走到最后一步，手里是终点的值。
en: Action: return 1 (or any number ≥ 0.5) = stop now, and the value in hand is fixed at this step's s.x; return 0 = keep going. If you never stop, the path runs to the last step and the value in hand is the final value.

zh: s.x          路径现在的值（开局是 0）；s.p(k) 是 k 步之前的值
en: s.x          Current value of the path (0 at the start); s.p(k) is the value k steps ago

zh: s.hi(n)      最近 n 个值里最大的（s.hi(s.t + 1) 就是开局到现在的最高点）；s.lo(n) 是最小的
en: s.hi(n)      The largest of the last n values (s.hi(s.t + 1) is the maximum from the start until now); s.lo(n) is the smallest

zh: s.ret(k)     最近第 k+1 步的增量；s.mean(n)、s.vol(n) 是最近 n 个增量的均值、标准差
en: s.ret(k)     Increment of the (k+1)-th most recent step; s.mean(n) and s.vol(n) are the mean and the standard deviation of the last n increments

zh: s.g.T        一局多少步；s.t 现在是第几步（从 0 起）；s.g.mu 每步的漂移（均值回复的世界里记作 0）
en: s.g.T        Number of steps per episode; s.t is the current step number (counting from 0); s.g.mu is the drift per step (set to 0 in the mean-reverting world)

zh: 规则不知道这是哪一种世界。计分只看停下的地方离整条路径最高点的距离（包括你停下之后才出现的最高点）。
en: The rule does not know which kind of world this is. Scoring looks only at the distance from where you stopped to the maximum of the whole path (including a maximum that appears only after you have stopped).
